description: A stone castle courtyard at dusk under a purple sky. A young woman with long braids, in a steel breastplate over a maroon leather jacket, black leather trousers and tall boots, draws a longbow and shoots; her arrow hits a round target on a wooden log among several arrows clustered in its red centre, and splinters fly. She lowers the bow, turns and grins proudly. A young man in a padded navy tunic holding another bow watches behind her, and a fire burns in an iron basket under a stone arch.
